Parallax launcher

The home screen for your TV, with the same idea as the Parallax home: app icons along the top, and below them, big cards for only the app you're on. Each app has a few sections, one open at a time with a bar for the next. Left and right spring, up and down glide. Select Parallax to see the handover into the app. Try the "At sea" button to see how it stays full offline.

Icons:

The colored icons are stand-ins with invented colors, to show how a mix of full-color icons sits in the design; on the box each app shows its own real icon in its own colors. All titles and artwork are placeholders.
